justification: None of these articles report human (or animal) genetic variants in KCNC1 associated with epilepsy or seizures; there is no clinical or family study at all, so Established and Existing are essentially excluded. However, because epilepsy or seizures are never mentioned in these abstracts, a substantial portion of probability remains on Novel (mere incidental relevance as of 1995).
